result.title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
result.summary: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native \emph{League of Legends} with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse--keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0\% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3\% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. Trajectories reveal incomplete subgoal composition and actions executing after the observed scene changes, motivating agents that combine visual reasoning with timely action.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LOLPlay，一个在《英雄联盟》原生环境中评测实时视觉智能体的基准，含 36 个英雄专属任务与 82 项可执行子目标检查，智能体仅通过截图和鼠标键盘交互；对三个模型在三种推理强度下共 324 次评测显示，提高推理强度并不提升任务或子目标成功率，且更长推理会压缩可用交互轮数，轨迹还显示子目标组合不完整、动作滞后于场景变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作为「THINK 越多是否越好」与推理预算—及时执行的权衡提供了直接诊断证据，其推理长度挤占交互轮数、动作滞后于观测变化的发现，可供核查 LVR 中停止决策与动态计算分配的设计；但任务为游戏操作，未涉及 latent 状态表示。
